All arise, for the night has eyes….description: This Chanty is a soft melodic one, but the words have an implicit warning. It is usually sung at night; it helps make everyone on board the ship calm and restful but keeps those on watch alert. Anyone trying to remain awake gets +20 on any Test that might result in them falling asleep, and they also get +10 to any Perception Test.
All arise, for the night has eyes….name: All arise, for the night has eyes…

Anchor (Large).description:
This Upgrade fits boats of Large size and bigger.

A ship without an Anchor has no way to fix itself in place when at sea. A ship that deploys its Anchor in a suitable location (many parts of the ocean are too deep) is not affected by winds or currents whilst the anchor is lowered.

Raising an Anchor is not an easy process. If an Anchor needs to be raised in a hurry the crew must work hard at the capstan; an Extended Strength Test is required to raise the Anchor. The difficulty of the Test depends on the Size of the ship (typically it will be Difficult (–10) for Small or Average ships and Hard (–20) for bigger boats), and the total SL needed depend on the depth of the Anchor (a typical value would be 15 SL).
Anchor (Large).name: Anchor (Large)

Armour Plating (Bronze – Large).description:
This Upgrade fits boats of Large size and bigger.

Armour Plating may only be added at specialised shipyards, and involves the skills of expert smiths as well as shipwrights. Adding the armour takes two weeks for Tiny to Average ships, and a month for larger ships.

Armour on a vessel works in much the same way as armour on a character. The Damage of hits to the Hull is reduced by the AP as well as the TB. Unlike personal armour, ship armour may not be sacrificed to avoid Critical Wounds.

Bronze: The Hull benefits from 1 AP.

This represents 5 yards of length of Armour Plating. Please modify this item's Price and Encumbrance according to how many 5 yard lengths were used.

Armoured.description:
This boat is built for fighting, with reinforcements and wooden and metal plates added at strategic locations. Each level of this Trait adds 10 to the Toughness of a vessel. Ships can have up to 3 levels of Armoured.

  • Subtract 10% of the base Carries and add 10% to the base Cost per level of Armoured.

This is a Vehicle Trait intended to be used with @UUID[JournalEntry.NJKfopwceEtoR3tl]{Boats}
Armoured.name: Armoured

Barrel of Fresh Water.description: Fresh water is usually stored in great barrels and doled out carefully. A good captain knows to make sure the ship is over-supplied, especially on voyages into unknown seas. On such a voyage, a captain should take every opportunity to replenish their supply. A barrel contains 32 gallons of water. A member of a crew drinks a gallon per day.
Barrel of Fresh Water.name: Barrel of Fresh Water

Barrel of Small Beer.description: Sometimes small beer is used instead of water; this helps keep the water uncontaminated, and though the beer is alcoholic, it is so dilute as to be hydrating. A barrel of water and a keg of ale can produce a barrel of small beer. The Bretonnian Navy uses diluted wine instead.
Barrel of Small Beer.name: Barrel of Small Beer

Batten Down the Hatches.description: Where a smaller vessel would make Boat Handling Tests to avoid damage resulting from strong winds, a larger vessel may benefit from quick decision making by the Captain and swift action by the crew.
Batten Down the Hatches.name: Batten Down the Hatches

Blasted Hull.description:
Deep gouges appear in the hull. Splinters 4. Any Characters on deck must make an Average (+20) Athletics Test or gain the @Condition[Prone] Condition.

Repair: Extended Easy (+40) Trade (Carpentry) Test to a total of 20 SL to clean and patch the hull.
Blasted Hull.name: Blasted Hull

Blessed Voyage.description: This Miracle may be performed whenever it is time for a ship to calculate Manann’s Mood. You perform the rites thought best to supplicate Manann. His mood improves by [[/r 2d10]], –1 for each Sin Point you currently have.
Blessed Voyage.name: Blessed Voyage

Blessing of the Albatross.description: Upon completing the invocation, an albatross descends from the clouds and follows the ship. The albatross waits up to 1 hour for the ship to sail, and after that, it stays with the ship until the duration expires. As long as the albatross is present, the ship cannot sink, no matter how much damage it takes. Should the albatross be killed, the ship suffers from [[/r d10 * -1]]{–d10} Morale and [[/r 2d10 * -1]]{–2d10} for Manann’s Mood (should you need statistics for an albatross, treat it as a @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.actors.Actor.ge5zXH2qboxaac7v]{pigeon}, though its Size is Small and it has 3 Wounds).
Blessing of the Albatross.name: Blessing of the Albatross

Blessing of the Mariner.description: Your blessing grants a character an instinctive feel for the sea and sailing. Any Row, Sail, or Swim Tests they make benefit from +1 SL.
Blessing of the Mariner.name: Blessing of the Mariner

Blessings of Bel Shanaar.description:
This spell must be cast while on a journey with a set destination, the location of which is known to the caster. Closing your eyes, you focus your Second Sight on the heavens, tracing Azyr’s path as it crackles across the sky, seeming to jump from star to star. For an instant a bolt of Azyr connects you to your destination, leaving a shimmering blue afterimage in your vision. For the duration of the spell, all Navigation Tests made by the wizard (or involving the wizard, in the case of Crew Tests) benefit from +2 SL.

Lore: Spells causing Damage ignore Armour Points from metal armour, and will arc to all other targets within 2 yards, except those with the Arcane Magic (Heavens) Talent, inflicting hits with a Damage equal to your Willpower Bonus, handled like a magical missile.
Blessings of Bel Shanaar.name: Blessings of Bel Shanaar

Blood Trail.description: When trying to track someone who has been injured, you smell the smallest drops of blood even if some attempt has been made to remove them. You can follow their trail over land and water by passing an Easy (+40) Track Test.
Blood Trail.name: Blood Trail

Boat Handling for Manoeuvres.description: Whenever a vessel is called upon to make a Boat Handling Test in order to manoeuvre around a tight bend or obstacle, it can be performed as a Crew Test. The character at the Helm is most important here.
Boat Handling for Manoeuvres.name: Boat Handling for Manoeuvres

Boat Handling for Progress.description: When determining whether a large ship makes good progress in normal conditions, a Crew Test can be made in place of a @UUID[JournalEntry.IyprYPBVX3cxxO2w.JournalEntryPage.u4omHzrETM5sRY07]{Boat Handling Test}.
Boat Handling for Progress.name: Boat Handling for Progress

Boat Handling for Progress in Pursuits.description: This sort of Test is all about speed. This is usually done in accordance with the @UUID[JournalEntry.IyprYPBVX3cxxO2w.JournalEntryPage.LnExkNT9qUrJQssr]{Chasing and Racing} rules. Deckhands trim the sails or man the oars, and so are vital to this task.
Boat Handling for Progress in Pursuits.name: Boat Handling for Progress in Pursuits

Breathe Water.description: Your prayers allow a character to breathe water as if it were air. When it comes to drowing in water, the character can ignore the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.journals.JournalEntry.NS3YGlJQxwTggjRX.JournalEntryPage.WCivInLZrqEtZzF4#drowning-and-suffocation]{Suffocation} rules for the duration of the Miracle. It is not possible to perform this Miracle while your own mouth is underwater.
Breathe Water.name: Breathe Water

Brine Drinker.description: Someone with this mutation can drink salt water without harm. In addition to its survival advantage at sea, it allows the mutant to spew a torrent of corrosive, stinging, salty vomit. This is a @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.JzeN9MZ0xUDvpE2l]{Vomit} attack, except that instead of taking damage the target must pass a Difficult (–10) Endurance Test or gain one @Condition[Blinded] Condition, and any metal armour they are wearing has its Armour Rating halved (round up), as the metal immediately begins to rust. The mutant’s skin is permanently covered with a salty wet crust, and they must drink a pint of briny sea water (not just water with salt added) every day, otherwise they gain a @Condition[Fatigued] Condition.
Brine Drinker.name: Brine Drinker

Captain.description: The Captain assesses the situation, gets information from some of the crew, decides on the action to take, and conveys that back to the crew.
Captain.name: Captain

Cargo Damaged.description: [[d100]] Enc points of cargo are ruined. Splinters 4.
Cargo Damaged.name: Cargo Damaged

Cargo Destroyed.description: [[2d100]] Enc points of cargo are ruined. Splinters 6.
Cargo Destroyed.name: Cargo Destroyed

Chanter.name: Śpiewak
skills: Play (Fiddle or Squeezebox or Tin Whistle)

Chanty.description:
This Talent allows a Character to learn a @UUID[JournalEntry.N73rKQn0RyQfphEc.JournalEntryPage.bF155OC9k6R0BP1x#list-of-chanties]{chanty}. Whenever a Character buys a new level in the Talent they learn a new song. A Chanty affects an entire crew. To use the talent the Chantyman should find a location within earshot of as many of the crew as possible and pass an Entertain (Singing) Test.

It takes 30 seconds for a Chantyman to establish the chanty, after which the effect lasts for three minutes plus a number of minutes equal to the SL on the Entertain (Singing) Test. The only combat action the Chantyman can make while the Chanty is being performed is a Dodge. Other actions can be made at the GM’s discretion, such as Perception Tests or Cool Tests. If the Chantyman takes damage or fails any Opposed Test their Chanty ends.

A Chanty may be sung at each watch. There’s only so much inspiration a crew can take.
Chanty.name: Chanty

Chanty Captain.name: Kapitan Szanciarzy
skills: Play (Fiddle or Squeezebox or Tin Whistle)

Chanty Master.name: Mistrz Szant
skills: Play (Fiddle or Squeezebox or Tin Whistle)

Chantyman.description: As well as using the Entertain (Sing) Skill to contribute to a Crew Test in a way similar to the rest of the crew, the Chantyman can use the ‘We’re all in this together so, heave ho, heave ho…’ Chanty to boost the rest of the crew’s Tests.
Chantyman.name: Chantyman

Compass.description: A rudimentary compass made from a needle balanced on a pin. Navigation Tests benefit from +1 SL with the aid of a compass.
Compass.name: Compass

Cook.description: An under-rated role, nothing makes a crew disgruntled quicker than bad food.
Cook.name: Cook

Crew Commander.description: A Character with this Talent is practised at managing crews of siege weapons and artillery pieces. The Character may make a Challenging (+0) Leadership Test to help a crew operating a weapon with the Crewed Flaw within earshot. If the Character passes the Test, the crew members may then use the Character’s Ranged Skill when shooting the weapon.
Crew Commander.name: Crew Commander

tests.value: Ranged Skill Tests when firing a weapon with the Crewed Flaw

Crow’s Nest (Large).description:
This Upgrade fits boats of Large size and bigger.

A Crow’s Nest is a wooden platform placed atop the tallest mast. A Character in the Crow’s Nest may take any Perception Tests called for to spot visible phenomena at sea, such as hazards, or the light from lighthouses. The Crow’s Nest provides +2 SL to Perception Tests.
Crow’s Nest (Large).name: Crow’s Nest (Large)

Crow’s Nest (Small).description:
This Upgrade fits boats up to Average size.

A Crow’s Nest is a wooden platform placed atop the tallest mast. A Character in the Crow’s Nest may take any Perception Tests called for to spot visible phenomena at sea, such as hazards, or the light from lighthouses. The Crow’s Nest provides +1 SL to Perception Tests.
Crow’s Nest (Small).name: Crow’s Nest (Small)

Curse of the Harsh Mistress.description: You inflict nightmares upon your target that make it impossible for them to get a good night’s sleep, resulting in lethargy and weakness. The nightmares are extremely vivid, disturbing, and connected to the ocean in some way; they commonly involve a woman draped in fronds of bloodwrack walking from the sea to torment the victim. Whilst under the influence of the Miracle the target must pass a Difficult (–10) Cool Test every time they take some rest to recover from @Condition[Fatigued] Conditions. If the Test is failed, the @Condition[Fatigued] Condition remains.
Curse of the Harsh Mistress.name: Curse of the Harsh Mistress

CwGesbC3fio2W6dJ.name: Szanciarz
skills: Play (Fiddle or Squeezebox or Tin Whistle)

Damaged Rudder.description:
The rudder is twisted and cracked. The ship’s Man Characteristic is reduced by 1. Splinters 1. Any Characters on deck must make an Average (+20) Athletics Test or gain the @Condition[Prone] Condition.

Repair: Extended Challenging (+0) Trade (Carpenter) Test to a total of 10 SL.
Damaged Rudder.name: Damaged Rudder

Day’s Ration of Fermented Cabbage Broth.description: Fermented cabbage broth tastes awful and crews dislike it immensely. The Imperial Navy has recently decreed that those who do not imbibe their daily ration are to be flogged. This still does not stop seamen throwing theirs overboard when officers are not looking. Any ship’s cook able to make this broth appetising is much sought after.
Day’s Ration of Fermented Cabbage Broth.name: Day’s Ration of Fermented Cabbage Broth

Day’s Ration of Hard Tack.description: The famous ship’s biscuit, or hardtack, is important as it provides much needed calories, is cheap to make, compact and light for storage, and lasts a long time without spoiling. It is hard as rock, however, and requires soaking before it can be easily eaten. The weevils that infest the biscuits are just extra nutrition. Hard tack is all that is needed to stave off starvation, though it is a poor diet.
Day’s Ration of Hard Tack.name: Day’s Ration of Hard Tack

Day’s Ration of Preserves.description: Preserving and storing the large quantities of food required on a voyage is a problem. Salting meat is one effective preservative. Pickling vegetables is common, using vinegar, alcohol, or sugar.
Day’s Ration of Preserves.name: Day’s Ration of Preserves

Deckhand.description: Deckhands perform all the manual jobs on board. Despite their lowly position, their work is highly skilled and vital to the smooth running of the vessel.
Deckhand.name: Deckhand

Dodgy Tiller.description:
Wear and tear on the tiller or the steering system has caused weakness. The next time a Manoeuvre Test is failed with –3 SL or more, the tiller breaks. It will not be possible to steer the boat until the tiller is repaired.

Repair: Hard (–20) Perception Test to spot the damage. Extended Easy (+40) Trade (Carpenter) Test to a total of 10 SL to fix it.
Dodgy Tiller.name: Dodgy Tiller

Experimental.description:
For every hour in use, a Challenging (+0) Trade (Engineering) Test is required. For any doubles rolled on a failure, something breaks. This can happen up to the Trait’s rating before the craft stops working.

This is a Vehicle Trait intended to be used with Vehicle type Actors.
Experimental.name: Experimental

Fast.description:
Speed Modifier: +1

Carries Modifier: Reduce Carries by 25%

This is a Vehicle Trait intended to be used with @UUID[JournalEntry.NJKfopwceEtoR3tl]{Boats}
Fast.name: Fast

Faster.description:
Speed Modifier: +2

Carries Modifier: Reduce Carries by 50%

Cost Modifier: +10%

This is a Vehicle Trait intended to be used with @UUID[JournalEntry.NJKfopwceEtoR3tl]{Boats}
Faster.name: Faster

Fastest.description:
Speed Modifier: +3

Carries Modifier: Reduce Carries by 75%

Cost Modifier: +10%

This is a Vehicle Trait intended to be used with @UUID[JournalEntry.NJKfopwceEtoR3tl]{Boats}
Fastest.name: Fastest

Figurehead.description:
Figureheads are brightly painted wooden sculptures attached to the front of a boat. They are thought to attract luck and help personalise the ship, as well as helping to show that the owner possesses wit and humanity. Most Figureheads depict aspects of Manann, a mermaid, or a romanticised personification of the owner’s heraldry or nationality.

If the Figurehead is particularly well made it becomes a source of pride for the crew. A Figurehead with two or more Fine Qualities adds 1 to the @UUID[JournalEntry.iXaDTQO8uxnTb0Jb.JournalEntryPage.ygJ2y5KSDlB1TK5L]{Morale} total.
Figurehead.name: Figurehead

Fire Battery.description: If an enemy is within range of the ship’s guns, this Crew Test can be performed if the Captain wishes to unleash a broadside upon them. Rather than rolling to hit for each cannon, the Fire Battery Crew Test can be taken, with the total SL applying to all guns facing the enemy, for better or worse.
Fire Battery.name: Fire Battery

Grim.description:
If, at the beginning of its turn, this creature does not have at least its Grim Rating in Advantage points, its Advantage pool immediately increases to its Grim Rating. If the creature currently has a @Condition[Surprised], @Condition[Unconscious], or @Condition[Entangled] Condition, it does not gain this Advantage.

If using the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-up-in-arms.journals.JournalEntry.JSMqi4MYrqsPBDUL.JournalEntryPage.njjUtJFlaiYB2ZMr]{Group Advantage} rules from Up in Arms, the creature generates its Grim Rating in Advantage for the Adversary Advantage Pool.
Grim.name: Grim

Grubark Gearing System.description:
This Upgrade fits boats of Little to Average size.

This vessel uses an ingenious yet simple gearing system to allow a handful of Dwarfs to operate a bank of sweeps. The minimum number of crew needed to row the boat is reduced to a quarter of its original number (rounding up any fractions). Rowers also benefit from +1 SL to Endurance Tests made to see if they become @UUID[JournalEntry.IyprYPBVX3cxxO2w.JournalEntryPage.u4omHzrETM5sRY07#exhaustion]{exhausted} after a shift at the oars.

The gearing system is a complex and intricate piece of machinery. If the Oars Location takes a Critical Hit, roll d10. On a 5 or more the gearing system is ruined in addition to the effects of the Critical Hit.
Grubark Gearing System.name: Grubark Gearing System

Gun Port (Large).description:
This Upgrade fits boats of Large size and bigger.

Gun Ports are closable hatches that allow a missile weapon to be fired from behind cover. Large Gun Ports can accommodate cannon or ballistae, while small Gun Ports are intended for handguns, bows, and crossbows.

If a ship has no Gun Ports, any shooting must be performed from the deck. The deck provides no cover, whilst a Gun Port provides Hard Cover. Opening or closing a Gun Port counts as a single action. Open Gun Ports can prove a liability if the ship begins to sink (see @UUID[JournalEntry.IyprYPBVX3cxxO2w.JournalEntryPage.Vmm5BPztRSNbFkfF#holed-(rating)]{Holed (Rating)}).
Gun Port (Large).name: Gun Port (Large)

Gun Port (Small).description:
This Upgrade fits boats up to Average size.

Gun Ports are closable hatches that allow a missile weapon to be fired from behind cover. Large Gun Ports can accommodate cannon or ballistae, while small Gun Ports are intended for handguns, bows, and crossbows.

If a ship has no Gun Ports, any shooting must be performed from the deck. The deck provides no cover, whilst a Gun Port provides Hard Cover. Opening or closing a Gun Port counts as a single action. Open Gun Ports can prove a liability if the ship begins to sink (see @UUID[JournalEntry.IyprYPBVX3cxxO2w.JournalEntryPage.Vmm5BPztRSNbFkfF#holed-(rating)]{Holed (Rating)}).
Gun Port (Small).name: Gun Port (Small)

Gunner.description: The Gunner oversees the boat’s weapons and is called upon in any sort of Fighting Test.
Gunner.name: Gunner

Hard Going.description:
This sort of Test is required on voyages where the ship has gone too long without sight of land, the objective is uncertain, the seas unknown, if nutrition is a problem, disease has taken hold, or there is some dread about the ship’s prospects.

The strains of the journey can begin to show, and crew morale will drop. While Characters can soldier on regardless, NPC crews will start to get uneasy. If the total of this Test results in negative SL, reduce the Morale by that amount in addition to other negative consequences.

The Hard Going Test is called for under specific circumstances, as noted in the rules for @UUID[JournalEntry.23L6RBHmImnMR9Ir.JournalEntryPage.iElrIisaPxns0zF7]{Extended Voyages}.
Hard Going.name: Hard Going

Helm.description: The Helm uses all their experience and familiarity with the elements to steer the ship.
Helm.name: Helm

Holed.description:
This is not an actual Critical. Use this Item whenever you need to manually add a Holed rating to a vessel manually.

To edit Rating to the Holed, edit the name of the Active Effect added onto your ship.
Holed.name: Holed

Holed Above the Waterline.description:
Holed 1. Splinters 6.

Repair: Extended Challenging (+0) Trade (Carpentry) Test to a total of 20 SL to repair the hole.
Holed Above the Waterline.name: Holed Above the Waterline

Holed Below the Waterline.description:
Holed 4. Splinters 2.

Repair: Extended Difficult (–20) Trade (Carpentry) Test to a total of 30 SL to repair the hole.
Holed Below the Waterline.name: Holed Below the Waterline

Holed on the Waterline.description:
Holed 2. Splinters 4.

Repair: Extended Hard (–10) Trade (Carpentry) Test to a total of 30 SL to repair the hole.
Holed on the Waterline.name: Holed on the Waterline

Jacques Bret came sailing to meet our st.description: This rousing Chanty tells of heroic feats in bloody battles. It pumps the blood of the crew and stirs them for the fight. It gives everyone in the crew +1 SL on any successful Melee Test.
Jacques Bret came sailing to meet our st.name: Jacques Bret came sailing to meet our steel!

Jetsam.description: [[d100]] Enc points of cargo are tossed overboard. Splinters 2.
Jetsam.name: Jetsam

Living Mire.description:
Facing a ship at sea, you produce a stream of seaweed. The slimy algae surrounds the vessel, which becomes enmeshed. Whilst caught in the mire the vessel suffers –2 to its Movement Characteristic, and adjusts its Manoeuvre Characteristic by –3 SL. A crew can be ordered to cut the ship free with an Extended Challenging (+0) Boat Handling Test, to a target number equal to the caster’s Willpower Bonus + SLs.

Lore: Receive a +10 bonus to Casting and Channeling rolls when in a rural or wilderness environment. Living creatures — e.g. those without the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.v3uzEthcq0JRar0J]{Daemonic} or @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.PFTD9gDvRWW9uh5g]{Undead} Creature Traits — targeted by Arcane Spells from the Lore of Life have all @Condition[Fatigued] and @Condition[Bleeding] Conditions removed after any other effects have been applied as life magic floods through them. Creatures with the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.PFTD9gDvRWW9uh5g]{Undead} Creature Trait, on the other hand, suffer additional Damage equal to your Willpower Bonus, ignoring Toughness Bonus and Armor Points, if affected by any spell cast with the Lore of Life.
Living Mire.name: Living Mire

Lookout.description: The Lookout’s role can be crucial when danger is close. They may roam the deck or stay at the bow, or on bigger boats, climb up to the precarious crow’s nest.
Lookout.name: Lookout

Loose Cannon.description:
One of the cannons breaks free and rolls about the deck. The crew of the cannon must make Challenging (+0) Athletics Tests or suffer a Damage 12 hit.

Repair: Extended Average (+20) Strength Test to return the cannon to its place.
Loose Cannon.name: Loose Cannon

Lost Anchor.description:
The vessel may no longer deploy its anchor.

Repair: Not possible — the item must be recovered or replaced. If suitable heavy items are onboard the ship, the GM may rule that a makeshift anchor could be improvised.
Lost Anchor.name: Lost Anchor

Lost Cannon.description:
One of the big guns, or a swivel gun if there are none, falls overboard and is lost.

Repair: Not possible — the item must be recovered or replaced.
Lost Cannon.name: Lost Cannon

Lost Ship’s Boat.description:
The ship’s boat, whether stored on deck or towed, is lost. Next time the crew needs to go ashore this could cause problems.

Repair: Not possible — the item must be recovered or replaced.
Lost Ship’s Boat.name: Lost Ship’s Boat

Luxury Cabins.description: Taking the space of two normal cabins, a Luxury Cabin allows the occupant to journey in comfort and style. At the GM’s discretion, any Fellowship Tests made by the owner of a Luxury Cabin gain a +10 bonus, provided they are made within the cabin.
Luxury Cabins.name: Luxury Cabins

Magazine Detonation.description:
Fire breaks out at the ship’s store of blackpowder and ammunition. The Cargo Location suffers three @Condition[Ablaze] Conditions and the ship takes [[/r d10]] Critical Hits to the Hull.

If the vessel has no need for a magazine and carries no store of blackpowder, a blazing fire breaks out instead. The Cargo Location suffers three @Condition[Ablaze] Conditions.
Magazine Detonation.name: Magazine Detonation

Maintenance.description:
Smaller vessels can suffer for the want of a trained carpenter, tailor, or boatbuilder when it comes to repairing damage and keeping the ship in good order. A larger vessel can rely on the collective wisdom of its crew to compensate for the lack of any one individual with such skills.

Any Tests made in order to effect repairs to the ship can be made using the Maintenance Crew Test.

This Test can be made in place of a Trade Skill needed to repair the boat. However, whilst many hands can help make light of such work, they do not make up for the lack of expert knowledge that a trained carpenter or tailor could provide. As such, if this Crew Test is taken in lieu of such Skills, it suffers from –2 SL.
Maintenance.name: Maintenance

Manann’s Mood Made Meaningless.description: You proclaim that Stromfels is the true lord of the sea, and that the superstitions of those who respect Manann are delusions. Once the miracle is in effect, roll on the @Table[manann-mood-made-meaningless] table and apply the result to the @UUID[JournalEntry.23L6RBHmImnMR9Ir.JournalEntryPage.QnZsr7CMsQvqi9tT]{Manann’s Mood} score for the ship you are currently aboard. Add 1 to the roll for every Sin Point you possess.
Manann’s Mood Made Meaningless.name: Manann’s Mood Made Meaningless

Marine Creature.description:
The creature is at home in the ocean and unsuited to life on land. The profiles of such creatures assume that they are in an aquatic environment and they move their full M in water. If they are removed from the water, their M drops to 1 and all Tests they make suffer from –2 SL.

Creatures with the Marine Creature Trait need to be moist to breathe properly. If they are removed from the water, they must be regularly doused with water or they will begin to suffocate as described in @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.journals.JournalEntry.NS3YGlJQxwTggjRX.JournalEntryPage.WCivInLZrqEtZzF4#drowning-and-suffocation]{Drowning and Suffocation}.
Marine Creature.name: Marine Creature

Mark of Khorne.description:
Khorne has marked this creature with a physical brand, proclaiming it sworn to his cause. The creature benefits from the Frenzy Talent. This creature gains the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.sYbgpSnRqSZWgwFP]{Etiquette (Followers of Khorne)} Talent and is subject to @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.Q2MCUrG2HppMcvN0]{Animosity} towards overt followers of Slaanesh. The creature is also subject to Animosity by followers of Slaanesh, so long as the Mark of Khorne is visible. The Character may never use the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.e3McIND4Rrsn5cE6]{Language (Magick)} or @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.V8eRx66SxB9Jha0Q]{Channelling} skills unless it is to dispel a spell.

Additonally they may purchase the following Talents as if they were Career Advances for the normal XP costs: @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.oRx92ByVNEBN6YkK]{Berserk Charge}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.0LdHytqyNmg2pcAX]{Combat Aware}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.tXKX29QZBdHmyMc7]{Combat Reflexes}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.BlHVzfs0Ow6IYEDw]{Furious Assault}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.xx8SgdWYEjKct7ym]{Implacable}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.eowbsW6oHGSNJmxV]{Magic Resistance}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.vMYEkrWj0ip6ZOdv]{Resistance (Magic)}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.uRvOg8AnCcP2ufx8]{Resolute}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.4MJJCiOKPkBByYwW]{Strike Mighty Blow}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.zGQ0ShUTSlUvVtWh]{Warrior Born}.
Mark of Khorne.name: Mark of Khorne

Mast Shattered.description:
The vessel may no longer move under sail. Splinters 10. Any Characters in the rigging must make a Difficult (–10) Athletics Test or fall.

Repair: Extended Hard (–20) Maintenance Crew Test to a total of 80 SL to rig together a makeshift sail capable of propelling the boat at [[/r d100]]{25%} of its normal speed. A full repair can only be made by reaching dry land and overhauling the vessel.
Mast Shattered.name: Mast Shattered

Master and Commander.description: You are respected and trusted by your crew. Any appropriate Leadership Test on board your ship or involving your crew gains an SL bonus equal to your levels in Master and Commander. This bonus applies to Crew Tests as well as individual Leadership Tests.
Master and Commander.name: Master and Commander

Navigation.description: Making sure the ship is on course is the Navigator’s job, though they do benefit from the advice of those on deck.
Navigation.name: Navigation

Navigator.description: Any Crew Test that involves finding a route requires a Navigator.
Navigator.name: Navigator

Niezlib’s Optimal Firing Solution.description:
This spell is a variation of one created by Lord Astromancer Wilfried-Gotthelm Niezlib, who sought to use it to prove his theories about the movement of celestial objects. He later realised it had more practical applications, and modified it to determine the exact moment a ship should fire a broadside. The caster can calculate the roll of the ship, distance to the target, weight of the cannonballs, and the power of each shot. For the duration of the spell, Tests made to fire a cannon benefit from +1 SL.

Lore: Spells causing Damage ignore Armour Points from metal armour, and will arc to all other targets within 2 yards, except those with the Arcane Magic (Heavens) Talent, inflicting hits with a Damage equal to your Willpower Bonus, handled like a magical missile.
Niezlib’s Optimal Firing Solution.name: Niezlib’s Optimal Firing Solution

Of all the terrors upon the sea….description: This steady, heart-warming melody can steel the hearts of a wavering crew. It gives them +1 SL to Cool Tests.
Of all the terrors upon the sea….name: Of all the terrors upon the sea…

Perception.description: Whenever circumstances call for a character on board a vessel to make a Perception Test to spot an oncoming hazard, sight of distant land, or signal from a lighthouse, it can be performed as a Crew Test. A Lookout is most useful here, but speedy reactions from others on deck may help prevent a collision.
Perception.name: Perception

Perforated Sail.description:
The sails of the boat are shot full of holes; the boat’s Sail M is reduced by 1 and Sail Tests suffer from –1 SL.

Repair: Extended Easy (+40) Trade (Tailor) Test to a total of 20 SL.
Perforated Sail.name: Perforated Sail

Pest Control.description:
Sometimes rats or other pests may infest a ship. In order to deal with the problem, the crew must perform an Extended Pest Control Test. Each Test requires the crew to devote d10 hours to clearing out the vermin. The difficulty and total SL needed to complete the extermination depends on the degree of infestation. A nest of rats on board would require a Challenging (+0) Extended Pest Control Test to a total of 10 SL.

If a Rat Catcher is aboard, they may take the vital role and use their Ranged (Sling) for the Test. The presence of a ship’s cat or small but vicious dog adds +1 SL to the result.
Pest Control.name: Pest Control

Pirate Captain.name: Pirate Captain
trappings: Fleet of Riverboats and Wrecker Crew

Quell Waters.description: You can chant this prayer, quelling a strong current. The M rating of a strait or whirlpool is reduced to 0 whilst the miracle is in effect.
Quell Waters.name: Quell Waters

Raging Seas.description: You command the sea to form a massive wave that crashes into a specific target, such as a person in the water or on the shore, a boat, or a lighthouse. The wave counts as having a CR of 15.
Raging Seas.name: Raging Seas

Ram (Enormous).description:
This Upgrade fits Enormous boats.

A metal Ram can be fitted to the front of a boat. The Ram provides the ship with 5 AP that can protect from any Damage resulting from a collision or attack coming from the front of the vessel. The ship also adds 5 to its Toughness Bonus when calculating its @UUID[JournalEntry.IyprYPBVX3cxxO2w.JournalEntryPage.9zNgf1DddKvKmIzN#collision-ratings]{Collision Rating} if it is the vessel causing the collision and strikes head on.
Ram (Enormous).name: Ram (Enormous)

Ram (Large).description:
This Upgrade fits Large boats.

A metal Ram can be fitted to the front of a boat. The Ram provides the ship with 5 AP that can protect from any Damage resulting from a collision or attack coming from the front of the vessel. The ship also adds 5 to its Toughness Bonus when calculating its @UUID[JournalEntry.IyprYPBVX3cxxO2w.JournalEntryPage.9zNgf1DddKvKmIzN#collision-ratings]{Collision Rating} if it is the vessel causing the collision and strikes head on.
Ram (Large).name: Ram (Large)

Ram (Monstrous).description:
This Upgrade fits Monstrous boats.

A metal Ram can be fitted to the front of a boat. The Ram provides the ship with 5 AP that can protect from any Damage resulting from a collision or attack coming from the front of the vessel. The ship also adds 5 to its Toughness Bonus when calculating its @UUID[JournalEntry.IyprYPBVX3cxxO2w.JournalEntryPage.9zNgf1DddKvKmIzN#collision-ratings]{Collision Rating} if it is the vessel causing the collision and strikes head on.
Ram (Monstrous).name: Ram (Monstrous)

Ram (Small).description:
This Upgrade fits Small and Average boats.

A metal Ram can be fitted to the front of a boat. The Ram provides the ship with 5 AP that can protect from any Damage resulting from a collision or attack coming from the front of the vessel. The ship also adds 5 to its Toughness Bonus when calculating its @UUID[JournalEntry.IyprYPBVX3cxxO2w.JournalEntryPage.9zNgf1DddKvKmIzN#collision-ratings]{Collision Rating} if it is the vessel causing the collision and strikes head on.
Ram (Small).name: Ram (Small)

Ram (Tiny).description:
This Upgrade fits Tiny and Little boats.

A metal Ram can be fitted to the front of a boat. The Ram provides the ship with 5 AP that can protect from any Damage resulting from a collision or attack coming from the front of the vessel. The ship also adds 5 to its Toughness Bonus when calculating its @UUID[JournalEntry.IyprYPBVX3cxxO2w.JournalEntryPage.9zNgf1DddKvKmIzN#collision-ratings]{Collision Rating} if it is the vessel causing the collision and strikes head on.
Ram (Tiny).name: Ram (Tiny)

Rattled Benches.description:
The seats upon which the rowers sit are scattered by the impact. Rowing may not take place until they are restored. Any Characters at the oars must make an Average (+20) Athletics Test or gain the @Condition[Prone] Condition.

Repair: Extended Easy (+40) Strength Test to a total of 10 SL to restore the benches.
Rattled Benches.name: Rattled Benches

Repel Sea Beast.description: You can chant this prayer to a sea creature, causing it to forget all rage and hunger whilst the miracle is in effect. For the duration of the miracle the creature will not make any hostile actions, provided that it suffers no damage or adverse Conditions.
Repel Sea Beast.name: Repel Sea Beast

target.value: 1 creature with the Aquatic Trait or the Marine Creature Trait

Rip Tides.description: You can chant this prayer at a ship you can see. The ship suffers –1 M and –1 SL to Man.
Rip Tides.name: Rip Tides

Rugged.description:
Rugged ships are generally unspectacular but well-made. They are tried and tested designs that have proved themselves on the high seas in the worst weather. Anything that is likely to fall off will have fallen off by now. A Rugged ship gets +2 SL to @UUID[JournalEntry.iXaDTQO8uxnTb0Jb.JournalEntryPage.anVE9Beit7XvtaUd#batten-down-the-hatches]{Batten Down the Hatches Crew Tests}.

  • Add 10% of the base Cost.

This is a Vehicle Trait intended to be used with @UUID[JournalEntry.NJKfopwceEtoR3tl]{Boats}
Rugged.name: Rugged

Ruined Keel.description:
The keel is shot through, making the boat altogether less stable. All Boat Handling Tests suffer from –1 SL until the keel is repaired. Any Characters on deck must make an Average (+20) Athletics Test or gain the @Condition[Prone] Condition.

Repair: The boat will need access to a slipway or dry dock followed by an Extended Challenging (+0) Trade (Carpentry) Test to a total of 20 SL to repair the keel.
Ruined Keel.name: Ruined Keel

Ruined Rigging.description:
The rigging has broken or snagged or fouled, the ropes are a mess and need to be cut off and replaced. Climb and Sail Tests suffer from –2 SL. Any Characters in the rigging must make a Challenging (+0) Athletics Test or fall.

Repair: Extended Challenging (+0) Sail Test to a total of 40 SL.
Ruined Rigging.name: Ruined Rigging

Ruined Rowlocks.description:
The rowlocks on one side of the ship are splintered, the boat’s Oars M is reduced by 1, and Row Tests suffer from –1 SL. The ship’s Man is reduced by –2 SL. Splinters 4.

Repair: Extended Challenging (+0) Trade (Carpenter) Test to a total of 20 SL.
Ruined Rowlocks.name: Ruined Rowlocks

Ruined Sail.description:
The sails are reduced to tatters. The vessel may no longer move under sail. Any Characters in the rigging must make an Average (+20) Athletics Test or take a fall.

Repair: Extended Difficult (–10) Trade (Tailor) Test to a total of 40 SL.
Ruined Sail.name: Ruined Sail

Scarred Hull.description:
The hull is scarred with gouges and powder burns. This looks unsightly and removes the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-soc.items.Item.FxEgpRITPIsnraK6]{Smoothing} Upgrade if the boat possesses it.

Repair: Extended Easy (+40) Trade (Carpentry) Test to a total of 10 SL to clean and patch the hull.
Scarred Hull.name: Scarred Hull

Scurvy.description:
Scurvy can afflict those who stay away from shore for extended periods. The cause of the disease is unclear. Bretonnian thought is that spending too long away from their beloved Bretonnia is naturally bad for you. Some blame it on weakness of character.

The disease starts with weariness, weakness, and ennui. Then it progresses to spontaneous bleeding and thinning blood which can turn into open sores. Then the sufferer’s bones weaken, and their teeth fall out.
Scurvy.name: Scurvy

contraction.value: Every month without correct nutrition requires a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test. Failure indicates that the Character has contracted scurvy. If the Character regularly eats fermented cabbage broth they make an Easy (+40) Endurance Test to resist contraction.

duration.text: The disease persists until 1d10 days after regularly eating fresh fruit and vegetables.

permanent.value: 1% chance of losing a tooth each day.

Sea Curse.description: You call doom down on the enemies of Manann. Provided the targeted ship is crewed by those who do not warrant the respect of Manann (followers of Chaos, worshippers of Stromfels, Orcs and Goblins, Skaven, crews who have a negative Manann’s Mood score), that crew suffer from a curse. Add 2 to the Damage of all hits the crew receives whilst the Miracle is in effect.
Sea Curse.name: Sea Curse

Sea Sickness.description: Most folk get seasick when they first sail, but anyone who sticks around will grow out of it. Elves tend to be immune, to the irritation of Dwarf sailors.
Sea Sickness.name: Sea Sickness

contraction.value: Whenever any Human, Dwarf, Halfling, or Ogre Character first undertakes a journey at sea, they must make a Difficult (–10) Endurance Test or suffer from sea sickness. In rough weather (Strong Gales or Violent Storms), such Characters should make a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or suffer from sea sickness.

duration.text: For sea sickness due to being new to seafaring, make a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test after each day at sea. If the Test is passed, the Character will not suffer this form of sea sickness again. For sea sickness resulting from rough seas or other temporary effects, make a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test every hour.

Sea of Glass.description:
You call on everyone on your vessel to be quiet, then close your eyes. An eerie silence envelops first your ship, then the surrounding sea. The sails go slack and the waves calm. The @UUID[JournalEntry.IyprYPBVX3cxxO2w.JournalEntryPage.8Gv2fWg0SzqOBUjv#becalmed]{Doldrums effect} from the Wind Effect Table applies for the duration of the spell.

Lore: Spells causing Damage ignore Armour Points from metal armour, and will arc to all other targets within 2 yards, except those with the Arcane Magic (Heavens) Talent, inflicting hits with a Damage equal to your Willpower Bonus, handled like a magical missile.
Sea of Glass.name: Sea of Glass

Sealskin.description: A sealskin overcoat keeps its wearer warm and dry. They usually come with over-mittens which are great for keeping hands warm but make dextrous acts impossible. A good sealskin can give a bonus of +1 SL to Endurance Tests made to resist cold exposure.
Sealskin.name: Sealskin

Seasickness.description: You curse someone, even the saltiest of seadogs, with a bout of seasickness that lasts for one hour. See @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-soc.items.Item.8Q9JYtR1y3B5J6UH]{Sea Sickness} for details.
Seasickness.name: Seasickness

Send ‘em to Stromfels.description: You focus on a stricken vessel, exerting your will to ensure that none escape. Splits and tears in the target ship’s hull widen as a result of the miracle. Double the target ship’s @UUID[JournalEntry.IyprYPBVX3cxxO2w.JournalEntryPage.Vmm5BPztRSNbFkfF#holed-(rating)]{Holed Rating}.
Send ‘em to Stromfels.name: Send ‘em to Stromfels

Shattered Bowsprit.description:
The vessel may no longer make use of a Flying Jib if it is equipped with one. Splinters 2.

Repair: Extended Challenging (+0) Trade (Carpenter) Test to a total of 40 SL.
Shattered Bowsprit.name: Shattered Bowsprit

Shattered Oars.description:
The oars on one side of the ship are shattered, the boat’s Oars M is reduced by 2, and Row Tests suffer from –2 SL.Splinters 5.

Repair: Extended Difficult (–10) Trade (Carpenter) Test to a total of 20 SL.
Shattered Oars.name: Shattered Oars

Shattered Rudder.description:
The rudder is destroyed. The ship’s Man Characteristic is reduced by 3. Splinters 3. Any Characters on deck must make an Average (+20) Athletics Test or gain the @Condition[Prone] Condition.

Repair: Extended Hard (–20) Maintenance Crew Test to a total of 80 SL to rig together a makeshift rudder. Even with this in place, the ship’s Man Characteristic is reduced by 1. A full repair can only be made by reaching dry land and overhauling the vessel.
Shattered Rudder.name: Shattered Rudder

Ship Parts.description: ‘Ship parts’ is a collective term covering timbers shaped to fit the hull, pitch to waterproof the boat, rope to repair the rigging and cloth to patch the sails. Ship parts are used up when undertaking the @UUID[JournalEntry.23L6RBHmImnMR9Ir.JournalEntryPage.QxgO7D6j0pWxRfwG#ship-maintenance]{Ship Maintenance} Endeavour.
Ship Parts.name: Ship Parts

Ship’s Boat.description:
Cost: As per the design of the Ship’s Boat.

Weight: As per the design of the Ship’s Boat.

If a ship has a sufficient Carries capacity, it may carry another boat. This could be used to ferry cargo or passengers between the main ship and port, as a life raft in an emergency, or even to tow the larger boat (at M1 and Man –4 SL).
Ship’s Boat.name: Ship’s Boat

Shivered Oars.description:
The oars on one side of the ship are cracked, the boat’s Oars M is reduced by 1, and Row Tests suffer from –1 SL.Splinters 2.

Repair: Extended Challenging (+0) Trade (Carpenter) Test to a total of 10 SL.
Shivered Oars.name: Shivered Oars

Slow.description:
Speed Modifier: –1

Carries Modifier: Add 25% to Carries

This is a Vehicle Trait intended to be used with @UUID[JournalEntry.NJKfopwceEtoR3tl]{Boats}
Slow.name: Slow

Slower.description:
Speed Modifier: –2

Carries Modifier: Add 50% to Carries

Man Modifier: –1 SL

This is a Vehicle Trait intended to be used with @UUID[JournalEntry.NJKfopwceEtoR3tl]{Boats}
Slower.name: Slower

Slowest.description:
Speed Modifier: –3

Carries Modifier: Double Carries

Man Modifier: –2 SL

This is a Vehicle Trait intended to be used with @UUID[JournalEntry.NJKfopwceEtoR3tl]{Boats}
Slowest.name: Slowest

Smashed Benches.description:
The seats upon which the rowers sit are torn apart. Rowing may not take place until they are restored.Splinters 6. Any Characters at the oars must make a Difficult (–20) Athletics Test or gain the @Condition[Prone] Condition.

Repair: Extended Hard (–20) Trade (Carpenter) Test to a total of 40 SL.
Smashed Benches.name: Smashed Benches

Smoothing (Large).description:
This Upgrade fits boats of Large size and bigger.

The boat’s hull is smoothed to remove any irregularities that might cause unnecessary drag. Initial Smoothing of a hull takes two weeks for larger ships. A smooth hull gives the boat M +1.

@UUID[JournalEntry.IyprYPBVX3cxxO2w.JournalEntryPage.yZyM2XU34LuzqpyE]{Repairing} a smoothed hull costs 50% more than normal. Cheaper repairs lose the benefits of the Smoothing.

This represents 5 yards of length of Smoothing. Please modify this item's Price and Encumbrance according to how many 5 yard lengths were used.
Smoothing (Large).name: Smoothing (Large)

Smoothing (Small).description:
This Upgrade fits boats up to Average size.

The boat’s hull is smoothed to remove any irregularities that might cause unnecessary drag. Initial Smoothing of a hull takes one week at a boatyard for Tiny to Average ships. A smooth hull gives the boat M +1.

@UUID[JournalEntry.IyprYPBVX3cxxO2w.JournalEntryPage.yZyM2XU34LuzqpyE]{Repairing} a smoothed hull costs 50% more than normal. Cheaper repairs lose the benefits of the Smoothing.

This represents 5 yards of length of Smoothing. Please modify this item's Price and Encumbrance according to how many 5 yard lengths were used.
Smoothing (Small).name: Smoothing (Small)

Splintered Mast.description:
The mast is cracked and creaks ominously. Splinters 6. Until the mast is repaired, make an Easy (+40) Endurance Test for the ship each turn. Failure results in a @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-soc.items.Item.d4bCnR1zINTNF9VC]{Mast Shattered} Critical Wound.

Repair: Extended Difficult (–10) Trade (Carpenter) Test to a total of 40 SL.
Splintered Mast.name: Splintered Mast

Steam Engine.description:
A boat powered by a steam engine has an M of 4 for as long as the fuel holds out, regardless of wind direction. It requires tending by a qualified engineer, with Trade (Engineer) Tests made for Boat Handling Tests.

Steam engines can be unreliable, though, and despite their size and bulk, their mechanisms are easily upset. Whenever a double is rolled on a failed Trade (Engineer) Test, or the result is an Astounding Failure, or the boat takes a Critical Hit to its Hull, roll on the @Table[steam-malfunction] table.
Steam Engine.name: Steam Engine

Storm Winds.description: You call the winds to blow with greater force into the sails of 1 ship. Increase the @UUID[JournalEntry.IyprYPBVX3cxxO2w.JournalEntryPage.8Gv2fWg0SzqOBUjv#winds]{intensity of the wind} by 1 step for the duration of the miracle. The direction of the wind is not affected.
Storm Winds.name: Storm Winds

Sturdy.description:
Sturdy ships are built to withstand the rigours of war. Boats can have up to three levels of Sturdy, and each level increases the Wounds of a vessel by 30%.

  • Subtract 10% of the base Carries and add 20% to the base Cost for each level of Sturdy.

This is a Vehicle Trait intended to be used with @UUID[JournalEntry.NJKfopwceEtoR3tl]{Boats}
Sturdy.name: Sturdy

Surgeon.description: The Surgeon is vital to the crew’s wellbeing after combats or when disease is aboard.
Surgeon.name: Surgeon

The ladies of L’Anguille….description: This bawdy song has countless verses, and sailors are encouraged to add their own to the risqué litany. This is designed to amuse and lift morale. Anyone joining in the song can ignore one Condition.
The ladies of L’Anguille….name: The ladies of L’Anguille…

They do say do as the Captain do say….description: This song about the many heroic deeds of the fictional Captain Vriez Van Vijnen instils a sense of optimism and trust in the ship’s captain. Any Fellowship Test attempted by the Captain, or other authority figure on board, targeted at the crew, gets a +20 bonus.
They do say do as the Captain do say….name: They do say do as the Captain do say…

Torn Below the Waterline.description:
Whilst the hull remains sound, the damage causes irregularities in its structure resulting in the vessel’s Man score being adjusted by –1 SL.

Repair: The boat will need access to a slipway or dry dock followed by an Extended Easy (+40) Trade (Carpentry) Test to a total of 20 SL to patch the hull.
Torn Below the Waterline.name: Torn Below the Waterline

Torn Ropes.description:
Part of the rigging becomes damaged and is about to break. Should a member of the crew climb the rigging before repairs are made, there is a [[/r d100]]{25%} chance that they stress the weakened rigging. If this is the case, the crew member must pass a Difficult (–10) Athletics Test or suffer a fall from the rigging.

Repair: Hard (–20) Perception Test to spot the damage. Extended Easy (+40) Sail Test to a total of 10 SL to fix it.
Torn Ropes.name: Torn Ropes

Torn Sail.description:
The sails are significantly ripped; the boat’s Sail M is reduced by 2 and Sail Tests suffer from –1 SL.

Repair: Extended Average (+40) Trade (Tailor) Test to a total of 30 SL.
Torn Sail.name: Torn Sail

Unwieldy.description:
Utilitarian boats intended to work close to shore or on calm seas are cobbled together by amateur shipwrights, or commissioned by owners looking to scrimp on the cost. The poorly designed craft can take up to 3 levels of the Unwieldy Trait to represent their design flaws. Each level imposes a penalty of –1 SL to any Sail Tests or Row Tests.

  • Subtract 10% of the base Cost per level of Unwieldy.

This is a Vehicle Trait intended to be used with @UUID[JournalEntry.NJKfopwceEtoR3tl]{Boats}
Unwieldy.name: Unwieldy

Upset Capstan.description:
The ship’s anchor plunges into the depths and may not be raised until the capstan is fixed. Each turn there is a [[/r d100]]{10%} chance of the anchor snagging on something and preventing the ship from moving.

Repair: Extended Easy (+40) Trade (Engineer) Test to a total of 10 SL to fix the capstan, or the anchor may be raised through an Extended Very Hard (–30) Strength Test to a total of 20 SL.
Upset Capstan.name: Upset Capstan

Water Brakes (Average).description:
This Upgrade fits Average boats.

This apparatus consists of two broad wooden flaps that can be unfolded from the sides of the boat. When moving forwards, opening the brakes increases drag and reduces Movement by 1 or 2 points, depending on whether they are opened halfway or fully. If deployed whilst in a strait or whirlpool, they increase the effective M of the current by a similar amount.
Water Brakes (Average).name: Water Brakes (Average)

Water Water Everywhere.description:
You gather Ghyran from the sea, taking small amounts of water with it. Cleansed of impurities, this water flows to the ship’s stores, replenishing any empty barrels of water.

Lore: Receive a +10 bonus to Casting and Channeling rolls when in a rural or wilderness environment. Living creatures — e.g. those without the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.v3uzEthcq0JRar0J]{Daemonic} or @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.PFTD9gDvRWW9uh5g]{Undead} Creature Traits — targeted by Arcane Spells from the Lore of Life have all @Condition[Fatigued] and @Condition[Bleeding] Conditions removed after any other effects have been applied as life magic floods through them. Creatures with the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.PFTD9gDvRWW9uh5g]{Undead} Creature Trait, on the other hand, suffer additional Damage equal to your Willpower Bonus, ignoring Toughness Bonus and Armor Points, if affected by any spell cast with the Lore of Life.
Water Water Everywhere.name: Water Water Everywhere

We’re all in this together so, heave ho,.description: This Chanty will spread a spirit of cooperation and make the crew knuckle down and go about the running of the ship with vigour and confidence. It gives a +10 modifier to the individual Tests of every crew member involved in any Crew Test.
We’re all in this together so, heave ho,.name: We’re all in this together so, heave ho, heave ho…

Whirlpool.description:
You pull on the Ghyran surrounding the target area, moving it around and around. The water starts to churn, and a @UUID[JournalEntry.IyprYPBVX3cxxO2w.JournalEntryPage.5d8bEBfyxc83o38D#whirlpools]{whirlpool} forms in the target area. The spell creates an area of Gentle Rotation, but SL can be spent on making the whirlpool larger as per the Overcasting rules.

Lore: Receive a +10 bonus to Casting and Channeling rolls when in a rural or wilderness environment. Living creatures — e.g. those without the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.v3uzEthcq0JRar0J]{Daemonic} or @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.PFTD9gDvRWW9uh5g]{Undead} Creature Traits — targeted by Arcane Spells from the Lore of Life have all @Condition[Fatigued] and @Condition[Bleeding] Conditions removed after any other effects have been applied as life magic floods through them. Creatures with the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.PFTD9gDvRWW9uh5g]{Undead} Creature Trait, on the other hand, suffer additional Damage equal to your Willpower Bonus, ignoring Toughness Bonus and Armor Points, if affected by any spell cast with the Lore of Life.
Whirlpool.name: Whirlpool

XVBo8FE3Kz1KoySD.description:
Khorne has marked this creature with a physical brand, proclaiming it sworn to his cause. The creature benefits from the Frenzy Talent. This creature gains the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.sYbgpSnRqSZWgwFP]{Etiquette (Followers of Khorne)} Talent and is subject to @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.Q2MCUrG2HppMcvN0]{Animosity} towards overt followers of Slaanesh. The creature is also subject to Animosity by followers of Slaanesh, so long as the Mark of Khorne is visible. The Character may never use the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.e3McIND4Rrsn5cE6]{Language (Magick)} or @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.V8eRx66SxB9Jha0Q]{Channelling} skills unless it is to dispel a spell.

Additonally they may purchase the following Talents as if they were Career Advances for the normal XP costs: @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.oRx92ByVNEBN6YkK]{Berserk Charge}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.0LdHytqyNmg2pcAX]{Combat Aware}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.tXKX29QZBdHmyMc7]{Combat Reflexes}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.BlHVzfs0Ow6IYEDw]{Furious Assault}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.xx8SgdWYEjKct7ym]{Implacable}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.eowbsW6oHGSNJmxV]{Magic Resistance}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.vMYEkrWj0ip6ZOdv]{Resistance (Magic)}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.uRvOg8AnCcP2ufx8]{Resolute}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.4MJJCiOKPkBByYwW]{Strike Mighty Blow}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.zGQ0ShUTSlUvVtWh]{Warrior Born}.
XVBo8FE3Kz1KoySD.name: Mark of Khorne

Yard Loosened.description:
One of the yards hangs loosely from the mast. The ship’s movement under sail is halved and Sail Tests suffer from –1 SL. Any Characters in the rigging must make an Average (+20) Athletics Test or fall.

Repair: Extended Average (+20) Sail Test to a total of 30 SL.
Yard Loosened.name: Yard Loosened

Yard Snapped.description:
One of the yards has snapped. The vessel may no longer move under sail. Splinters 8. Any Characters in the rigging must make a Challenging (+0) Athletics Test or fall.

Repair: Extended Difficult (–10) Trade (Carpenter) Test to a total of 50 SL.
Yard Snapped.name: Yard Snapped

You band of shipmates gather round….description: This is a round that encourages others to join in, and its gentle tempo and lyrics induce calm. It gives anyone in the crew +1 SL to any Fellowship Test intended to befriend or placate other members of the crew.
You band of shipmates gather round….name: You band of shipmates gather round…
